status: FROZEN by D-235 — D-207's template and coverage sentences (item-pilot-prompts-v1.json, unchanged), seam-contract-v2's modelDraws per category (the same text as v1's) and D-228's reference-sheet sentence per category (unchanged); only the garment differs. Never adjusted during the experiment.
template: Edit the stylised avatar illustration in Image 1. Keep the character exactly as it is: the same head, hair, face, expression, skin tone, body, pose, arms, hands, legs and feet, in the same position and size. Change only the clothing named here: {GARMENT}. Draw it in exactly the same painting style, outline weight and soft shading as Image 1. {COVERAGE} Do not change anything the new garment does not cover. No text, letters, numbers, logos or patterns unless named. Keep the background transparent.

coverage.top: The new top replaces the grey sleeveless top completely and covers everything it covered.
coverage.bottom: The new bottom replaces the dark grey shorts completely and covers everything they covered.
coverage.shoes: Keep the grey top and the dark grey shorts unchanged.

modelDraws.top: Replace the figure's grey base top completely — no grey left anywhere, also not at the lower side corners at the hips. Either end the hem exactly where the grey base top ends, or as a straight hip-length hem one third to one hand-width below it, the same distance across the whole width, and then at least a finger wider than the shorts at the hips. Long sleeves end just above the wrist and never touch the hand. No shadow on the trousers.
modelDraws.bottoms: Start exactly where the grey base top ends and draw nothing above it. Keep any waistband seam or belt within a finger-width of the top edge; no other horizontal line across the hips. At the hips stay as wide as the grey base shorts. Either end clearly above the ankle (shorts, skirts, capri: the leg shows above any shoe), or end just below the ankle with a straight, square hem that is wider than the leg on both sides.
modelDraws.shoes: Cover the foot up to at least the ankle. A boot shaft may go up to about one hand-width above the ankle, not higher, and stays close to the leg (no flared shaft). No shadow from trousers on the shoe.

reference.top: Image 2 is Image 1 with coloured guide marks; use it only to place the seams and never draw its colours or marks: the magenta area is the grey top that the new top must cover completely, its lower side corners included; the cyan line is where a waist-length hem ends; the green band is where a hip-length hem ends and how wide it must be at the hips; the cyan bars at the wrists are where long sleeves end.
reference.bottom: Image 2 is Image 1 with coloured guide marks; use it only to place the seams and never draw its colours or marks: the cyan line is where the grey top ends and the bottoms start; the red band is where no waistband seam, belt or other horizontal line may be; the magenta lines show how wide the bottoms may be at the hips; the yellow lines are the lowest a short or cropped hem may end; the green marks show how wide a long hem must be and the band where it ends, square.
reference.shoes: Image 2 is Image 1 with coloured guide marks; use it only to place the seams and never draw its colours or marks: the cyan lines are the ankle height the shoes must cover up to; the magenta lines are the highest a boot shaft may go; the green lines show how close to the leg the shoe must stay.
